injuries.name: Oskar Back
injuries.note: Back has an assist, five hits and nine blocks in seven appearances this season. While he's not expected to play Thursday in Vegas, perhaps he'll be an option Sunday versus Pittsburgh or Wednesday against Nashville.

injuries.name: Kyle Capobianco
injuries.note: Dallas also recalled Kyle Burroughs from AHL Texas on Saturday and placed Lian Bichsel (lower body) on injured reserve. Capobianco hasn't played since Oct. 27 against New Jersey. He hasn't earned a point in five appearances this season, but he has registered three shots on net, three blocked shots and two hits.

injuries.name: Lian Bichsel
injuries.note: Dallas also recalled Kyle Burroughs from AHL Texas on Saturday and moved Kyle Capobianco (leg) to long-term injured reserve. Bichsel is week-to-week after being injured in Thursday's 8-3 loss to Winnipeg. He has one assist, 10 shots on net, 24 blocked shots and 39 hits in 18 appearances this season.

injuries.name: Matt Duchene
injuries.note: The Stars placed Duchene on long-term injured reserve just before the start of the 2026-27 campaign. It remains unclear when he will return, but his new timeline could keep him out until at least mid-January. Duchene posted 16 goals, 45 points and 89 shots on net in 57 regular-season appearances for Dallas in 2025-26.

injuries.name: Elmer Soderblom
injuries.note: Pittsburgh moved Soderblom to injured reserve Wednesday, and he has already missed the last two games. It's unclear when he will be ready to return to the lineup. Soderblom has contributed one assist, five shots on net, four blocked shots and 15 hits in six appearances this season.

injuries.name: Ryan Graves
injuries.note: Graves will miss the beginning of the 2026-27 campaign, and it's unclear when he will be ready to return. He contributed one goal, 21 shots on net, 38 blocked shots and 23 hits in 22 regular-season appearances for Pittsburgh in 2025-26.
